tools.name: workinsiders_compare_tools
tools.description: Side by side comparison of 2 to 4 named tools: starting price, free plan and trial, MCP, API, AI-native, best for, watch-outs, bottom line and Capterra rating.

tools.name: workinsiders_find_alternatives
tools.description: Alternatives to one named tool: first the ones Work Insiders names in its write-up (with the reason), then others from the same category. Filterable by MCP, free plan and price.

tools.name: workinsiders_list_categories
tools.description: Lists every Work Insiders category (ATS, sourcing, email finders, AI interviewing, payroll and so on) with its slug, tool count and page link.

tools.name: workinsiders_category_overview
tools.description: What a category costs and who leads it: tool count, median public starting price, how many hide their price or have a free plan, how many run an MCP server, editor picks, cheapest public prices and the category intro.

tools.description: Which tools integrate with an applicant tracking system (Bullhorn, Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, JobAdder and others), from the Work Insiders ATS compatibility data. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: workinsiders_list_categories · Public sink: workinsiders_list_categories · Destructive: workinsiders_category_overview.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: workinsiders_list_categories · Public sink: workinsiders_list_categories · Destructive: workinsiders_category_overview

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
